name: Transfer, manifest, worker ve host state doğruluğu

scenarios.actualBehavior: Caught and rejected as CadError with INVALID_SCENE_MANIFEST

scenarios.faultInjected: Manifest with min: [NaN, -100] or reversed minX > maxX
scenarios.expectedBehavior: validateSceneManifest throws 'Geçersiz veya sonlu olmayan sahne sınırlayıcı kutusu'
scenarios.actualBehavior: Caught and rejected with detailed bbox error

scenarios.faultInjected: Manifest chunks array containing duplicated chunk ID 'chunk_01'
scenarios.actualBehavior: Caught and rejected duplicate chunk identifier

scenarios.faultInjected: Manifest chunk entry with malformed sha256 checksum 'not-a-valid-hash'
scenarios.actualBehavior: Caught and rejected non-64-hex SHA-256 hash

scenarios.faultInjected: Manifest has flat chunks ['chunk_01'] but indexPages has ['chunk_02']
scenarios.expectedBehavior: validateSceneManifest throws 'chunks ve indexPages parça kimlikleri çelişiyor'

scenarios.faultInjected: Host receives 9 out of 10 declared chunks in manifest
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Host stays in loading state; does NOT prematurely transition to ready (loadedCount === 1 bug removed)
scenarios.actualBehavior: isComplete returns false, expectedChunkIds vs loadedChunkIds set discrepancy correctly identified

scenarios.faultInjected: ArrayBuffer truncated to 32 bytes (less than 64-byte CAD2 header)
scenarios.actualBehavior: Caught and rejected truncated buffer without crashing process

scenarios.faultInjected: Vertex buffer with NaN or Infinity float32 coordinates
scenarios.expectedBehavior: validateBinaryChunkGeometry returns false / error for non-finite coordinates
scenarios.actualBehavior: Detected non-finite vertex data and prevented corrupted geometry feeding renderer

scenarios.faultInjected: Draw run with firstVertexIndex: 100, vertexCount: 50 when total vertices is 100
Chunk buffer bytes modified after manifest generation (checksum mismatch)
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Host verifies payload sha256 against manifest before sending to worker/renderer; drops corrupt chunk with non-retryable error
scenarios.actualBehavior: SHA-256 validation correctly flags mismatch and aborts processing
